note: Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target × 7/30. Hong Kong booked 1,055 GA4 bookings against an 899 blended weekly target, 17.4 percent ahead, up 6.8 percent week on week and up 13.8 percent year on year. Five of six venues beat the weekly target, led by The Chinese Library (+43.3 percent) and Cantina (+24.6 percent). Dim Sum Library (−7.2 percent) is the only venue below target this week. It and Aqua HK remain the two venues behind on the FY-to-date line (−8.2 and −6.0 percent), although Aqua HK beat its weekly target by 15.8 percent. Year to date the portfolio is 6.9 percent ahead of target. Hutong HK users rose 50.8 percent week on week, mostly visitors to its National Day firework dinner page, which produced no website bookings as a landing page, so its conversion rate fell to 6.8 percent from 9.6 percent. Vesu remains excluded from the portfolio view. It booked 101 this week against 100 the week before and 65 in the same week last year, a second week clear of the 2025 line.
